description.value: Arrow Lake Motel is a newly renovated, owner-operated motel situated in the small lakefront village of Fauquier, BC, right off the Needles Ferry on the eastern shore of Lower Arrow Lake. Originally built in 1968 and taken over by Ken and Liz Feiffer in 2016, it offers eleven air-conditioned rooms including five with kitchenettes. Its ferry-adjacent location makes it a natural stopover for touring cyclists crossing between the Arrow Lakes on the Needles-Fauquier route.
